items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: I had one of those Rudy Muck things.

ctx.x: I see. It's that, uh, I think we're going to do this one. Yeah. I'm pushing. It's deeper. Yeah. It's deeper. It's deeper. Yeah. I see. It's that, uh, thick rim on that. I guess that makes it easier on your lips or something. Better on your lips, yeah. Wow. Yeah, I studied trombone. Yeah. I had one of those Rudy Muck things. This is a Busher Trutone. Well, in the old days, what did they like? Did they like a deep cup, a medium, or... Well, I don't know. Different guys, I guess. Different things, you know. What…
